The**minister for institutional reforms**(Italian:*ministro per le riforme istituzionali*) is one of the positions in the[Italian government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_Italy).

The current minister is[Elisabetta Casellati](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elisabetta_Casellati), a member of the[Forza Italia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forza_Italia_(2013)), who has held the office since 22 October 2022 in the cabinet of[Giorgia Meloni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giorgia_Meloni).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minister_for_Institutional_Reforms#cite_note-1)
